agents.role: Main AI orchestrator that coordinates different AI services
Handles communication with Large Language Models (LLMs)
Extracts structured data from contracts using LLM or deterministic methods
Matches and resolves contract entities against existing records
Simulates royalty calculations based on contract terms
Guides users through contract creation workflow
Attaches source documents to release integration records
Plans and executes release validation workflows
Maps audio tracks to contract terms
Applies AI-extracted contract data to the system

pipelines.description: Main pipeline for ingesting and processing contracts through AI extraction, validation, and storage
Orchestrates release validation workflow including document attachment and persistence
Coordinates release integration processes including source contract verification
Maps audio tracks to contractual rights and obligations
Step-by-step workflow for creating contracts with AI assistance
Plans the attachment of AI-extracted contract data to existing records
Applies AI-generated core write proposals to the system

memory.description: PostgreSQL/SQLite database using SQLAlchemy ORM for persistent storage of contracts, users, royalties, and AI processing results
AI service registry that caches service instances and configuration
File-based storage for uploads, migrations, and configuration
Database migration scripts tracking schema evolution
